What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Kir Kanos (V)]]: left, the image of [[Kir Kanos (V) (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit d802972); right, the image of [[Kir Kanos (V) (Errata 3)]] (holotable commit 6489b69). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d802972eb306f188a313c2c599694e7f18f35cae/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/kirkanos.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/kirkanos.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
